intermediate.name: Twelve Bends Slope
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Twelve Bends Slope (124.3 km)

story: During Stage 3 of the Tour of Magnificent Qinghai 2026, a breakaway of eight riders, including Salby, formed after some delay. Salby secured all the sprint points. On the climb, the lead group fragmented, leaving Jonas Rapp as the last rider ahead. Cristian Rodríguez launched an attack from the favorites' group, followed by Caicedo. On the descent, a ten-rider group formed and eventually caught Jonas Rapp on the flat section before the finish. Mulubrhan triumphed in the sprint ahead of Caicedo and Fagundez.
